title: Atlantis as a multi-site Ice Age civilization
place_text: North America, Azores, Sahara, Amazon, submerged continental shelves

tellings.quote: but I think it was more than one place.

plain: Atlantis, the legendary lost civilization, may not have been one island but an advanced Ice Age culture spread across several places: North America, the Azores islands in the Atlantic, the Sahara, the Amazon, and coastlines now under the sea. The writer Graham Hancock offers this as his own view, saying "I think it was more than one place," and mentions the researchers Randall Carlson and Jimmy Corsetti. If true, it would mean a forgotten civilization was far larger than the old story suggests.
